_comment: Every collector fingerprint ever run, mapped by a person to a collection method. Written by scripts/collection-method.mjs; see lib/board-checks.mjs for why.

99b4a6dabe727975.note: First recorded method: board checks with request accounting, budget and ceiling partials, and per-board configuration hashes

284c3170f994573f.note: Non-role records screened out of the feed (information sessions, networking events and similar; lib/role-screen.mjs) and requisition labels cleaned off titles; duplicate groups reported only. Removes rows a healthy board yields, so days either side do not compare (l3vlup-skills#71)

14478f67929b3e92.note: Board-check records describe exactly what the feed publishes: rows the non-role screen drops are counted as screened, not kept, and every row takes its final published seat (IMC networking event, 25 Sep). Changes counts for boards with screened rows.

e9140383e5cacc68.note: Complete-board collection for boards flagged collect: complete in the registry (JPMorgan Chase, Barclays, ING, Capital One): the whole board read with an empty search to its own stated total and classified locally. ok only when one pass is strictly complete, or two passes of different page sizes agree exactly (lib/complete-board.mjs); otherwise partial, why unstable. Keyword paginators: the replay stop is per query, not per firm, so an overlapping later query is no longer cut short and recorded finished; one bounded retry per page. Changes which roles those four boards yield and can change what other Workday and Oracle boards yield; days either side do not compare.
